title: scopedVerify
responsibility: Runs the scenarios covering one entity, reports screenshot attachment status, narrows entity-scoped impact, and configures the verification environment.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.context
inputs.description: Verification context containing the target commit, repository root, and trusted head revision.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.runtime
inputs.description: Impact-analysis runtime selected for this scoped verification.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.options
inputs.description: Verification settings including the entity id and applicable runner/runtime options.

inputs.name: scopedVerify.env
inputs.description: Base environment inherited by scoped verification child processes.

inputs.name: renderAttachment.attachment
inputs.description: Optional screenshot attachment status returned for entity-scoped verification.

inputs.name: scopedContext.context
inputs.description: Entity-verification context containing the commit and head revision.

inputs.name: scopedImpact.head
inputs.description: Commit whose entity-scoped scenarios are being checked.

inputs.name: scopedImpact.runtime
inputs.description: Local impact runtime recorded in the scoped impact report.

inputs.name: timer.entity
inputs.description: Optional entity id; absent disables timing messages.

inputs.name: verifyEnv.options
inputs.description: Verify options used to derive resource priority and entity-scoped environment markers.

outputs.name: scopedVerify
outputs.description: Stored verification result for scenarios covering the entity; includes any screenshot-attachment outcome.

outputs.name: renderAttachment
outputs.description: Human-readable screenshot states, viewports, and attached record, or the reason no attachment was made.

outputs.name: scopedContext
outputs.description: Context whose base is replaced by the head so scoped proof does not claim a full comparison.

outputs.name: scopedImpact
outputs.description: Empty-impact report tagged with the requested head and runtime; selected tests and affected scenarios start empty.

outputs.name: timer
outputs.description: Callback that writes elapsed milliseconds for each named workflow step to stderr when an entity is set.

outputs.name: verifyEnv
outputs.description: Child-process environment copied from process.env with normalized resource priority and entity scope marker when applicable.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Entity is not covered by a scenario, or verification setup/runtime fails.
